applicationProxy.title: Application Proxy
applicationProxy.description: 规则模式先匹配订阅规则：直连和拒绝照常处理，需要代理时走该应用选定节点；未选节点时沿用订阅出口。代理模式全部流量走选定节点。关闭或未配置的应用沿用全局配置。 打开总开关会同步开启 TUN；关闭后本页不可配置，恢复全局分流。
applicationProxy.serviceRequired: TUN requires an available system service. Install or repair the service in Settings before enabling this mode.
applicationProxy.active: TUN is enabled and the core is in rule mode. Actual connection routes are shown below.
applicationProxy.inactive: Application settings are saved, but TUN or rule mode is currently unavailable. System-wide application routing is not active.
applicationProxy.pathHelp: Choose a macOS application to include its bundled helpers, or enter an absolute executable path. For terminal commands, select the actual network process such as git or curl.
applicationProxy.empty: No applications added. New applications start with proxying off.
applicationProxy.outbound: 分流模式 / 代理出口
applicationProxy.missingHelp: The selected outbound is absent from the current configuration. While this application switch is on, its matching connections are blocked. Select another outbound or turn the switch off.
applicationProxy.connectionHelp: Switches affect new connections. Disconnect existing application connections to reconnect with the new policy; this may interrupt downloads or sessions. Unidentified processes follow global routing. A proxy group may itself select a direct outbound; the displayed connection route is authoritative.
applicationProxy.disconnectFailed: Failed to disconnect {{count}} connections; other connections may already be disconnected.
applicationProxy.listFailed: Unable to load the application list. You can still enter an absolute application path.
applicationProxy.enabledEmpty: Drag an application here or turn on its switch below.
applicationProxy.pausedHelp: 开启应用分流总开关后，保存的应用设置生效。
applicationProxy.speedHelp: Upload and download speed of the current application connections. The first sample may take a moment.
applicationProxy.overview: {{count}} applications and processes · Switch or drag to configure
applicationProxy.selectBeforeEnable: 请选择应用使用的代理出口。规则模式保留直连和拒绝规则；代理模式全部流量走此出口。
applicationProxy.processDialogHint: 默认跟随父进程；单独修改为临时覆盖，进程退出后失效。
applicationProxy.noMatchingProcesses: 没有符合搜索条件的进程。
applicationProxy.noProcesses: 当前应用没有正在运行的进程。
applicationProxy.subscriptionRulesHint: 规则跟随所选订阅。切换订阅会清除原节点选择；规则模式不选节点时，沿用此订阅的分流出口。
applicationProxy.runningOnlyHelp: 只顯示有執行中處理程序的應用程式，即使目前沒有網路連線。
applicationProxy.runningEmpty: 沒有符合條件的執行中應用程式。
